findings.source_quote: (From authoritative English article) Endnote extracts: “'I should like to go into the enquiry-room.' I dare say you would, but we are not willing to pander to popular superstition. We fear that in those rooms men are warmed into a fictitious confidence. Very few of the supposed converts of enquiry-rooms turn out well. Go to your God at once, even where you now are. Cast yourself on Christ, at once, ere you stir an inch!' - Pleading and Encouragement – Charles Haddon Spurgeon – Aug 17, 1841"; "** What A Revival Of Religion Is – Charles Grandison Finney – ... 'A revival is not a miracle, or dependent on a miracle, in any sense. It is a purely philosophical result of the right use of the constituted means'"; "*** Spirit Force vs. Psychic Force – Watchman Nee (quote: 'We become like paper figures, having no power at all in ourselves...')"
findings.suggested_fix: Translate all quoted non-biblical passages (Spurgeon, Finney, Watchman Nee, and similar) into Norwegian Bokmål so that the quotations are presented in the target language. Preserve the citation metadata (author, work title, date/publisher details) exactly as in the source HTML, but render the quoted English prose into fluent Bokmål that faithfully conveys the original meaning. For example, translate Spurgeon's enquiry-room passage into Bokmål, keep the author and date marker in English if the source does so, but the quoted words must be in Norwegian. Do not leave the quoted prose in English; quoted substantive prose in the article must be translated.
